description: This file defines the 'Module' class, representing a modular component within the OpenMRS system. It includes properties for module metadata (name, id, version, author, description), dependencies, configuration settings, extensions, and lifecycle management methods. It is a core part of the OpenMRS module infrastructure, handling module loading, extension expansion, dependency resolution, and startup/error handling.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents an installable module in the OpenMRS system, encapsulating metadata, dependencies, extension points, configuration, and lifecycle methods to manage module behavior and integration within the platform.

methods.name: getModuleActivator
methods.description: Lazily loads and returns the ModuleActivator instance, using the module's class loader to instantiate the activator class if not already set.

methods.name: setModuleActivator
methods.description: Sets the ModuleActivator instance for this module.

methods.name: expandExtensionNames
methods.description: Expands extension points defined by class names into instantiated Extension objects, loading classes via the module's class loader.
